items.title: Both actual Picard query layers under the full phase law

source.anchor: Algorithm 3.1 and Lemma D.4, actual query centers before Jensen; D.7 and D.8 remain separate
source.attribution: Fan Chen, Sinho Chewi, Jianfeng Lu and Matthew S. Zhang; ASTIS explicitly scoped implementation restatement, not a full D.4 or main theorem.

items.statement: For the full independent driving law gamma=(Gaussian zeta0 product Gaussian zeta1) product (Gaussian array G0 product Gaussian array G1), and mu=nu product gamma, set a=exp(-h/2), sigma=sqrt(1-exp(-h)), MR=M+(1-exp(-h))*d, B=6MR+3eps^2+3eta*d and C=2+(1+log((1-c)^(-1)))/(-log c), d=finrank(E). There exist the same measurable exact proximal map p, actual stopped output q and natural index N, with p(y)+eta grad V(p(y))=y, ||q(y)-p(y)||<=eps and run(grad V,eta,eps,y,N(y)+1,y)=some(q(y),N(y)+1) for every y. Define P0=aP+sigma zeta0, Y0_i=X+t_i P0, Z0_j=grad V(q(Y0_j)+sqrt(eta) G0_j), Y1_i=Y0_i-sum_j omega_ij Z0_j, Z1_j=grad V(q(Y1_j)+sqrt(eta) G1_j), and Phi=(X+h P0-sum_j positionWeight_j Z1_j, a(P0-sum_j momentumWeight_j Z1_j)+sigma zeta1). Phi is measurable and gives a Markov kernel K(s)=gamma.map(z -> Phi(s,z)). For every i both gradient squares are integrable, with E_mu||grad V(Y0_i)||^2<=2MR and E_mu||grad V(Y1_i)||^2<=4MR+2S^2 B. Both actual counts N(Y0_i)+1 and N(Y1_i)+1 are integrable; their respective expectations are at most C[1+log(1+sqrt(2MR)/eps)] and C[1+log(1+sqrt(4MR+2S^2 B)/eps)].
assumptions: E is a complete finite-dimensional real inner-product space with its Borel sigma-algebra; i ranges over a finite index type of size J.
V is C2, kappa>=1, and kappa^(-1)||v||^2 <= D2V(x)[v,v] <= ||v||^2 for all x,v. Its actual gradient vanishes at the supplied xstar.
0<eta<=c<1, eps>0, h>=0, M>=0, S>=0. The incoming probability law nu on (X,P) has integrable ||X-xstar||^2+||P||^2, with integral at most M.

The supplied deterministic nodes satisfy |t_i|<=1 and each supplied omega row satisfies sum_j |omega_ij|<=S. Position and momentum weights are arbitrary supplied real arrays; source Chebyshev quadrature is not instantiated.

formulae.label: Actual implementation component
formulae.tex: M_R=M+(1-e^{-h})d,\quad B=6M_R+3\varepsilon^2+3\eta d,\quad A_0=2M_R,\quad A_1=4M_R+2S^2B,\quad \mathbb E_\mu[N(Y_i^k)+1]\le C_c[1+\log(1+\sqrt{A_k}/\varepsilon)],\quad k=0,1.

bindings.boundary: Single actual phase with arbitrary incoming L2 state budget and supplied bounded finite nodes/rows. Same q/N in the full Gaussian phase kernel, both center moments and both actual per-node query costs. No query-center gradient moment or count integrability/cost hypothesis. The run-wide D.7 induction, source quadrature/step selection, full-array direct/proximal execution aggregation D.8, Wp/proxy-warmness, initialization and main results remain separate; no TV-to-unbounded-cost transfer.
